entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help with that. I see from your number you're calling about a recent order. Is it about the VeloFit Pro cycling shoes?
Okay. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or a preference matter?
They just don't fit right. I keep getting terrible blisters on my heels, no matter how I position the cleats.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Alright, I see the order was delivered 43 days ago. Looking at our policy here, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a return for a full refund for you.
Fine. So what do I do?

I am generating a prepaid return label and I've just sent it to the email address on your account. You can just pack the cycling shoes back in their box, attach the label, and drop it off at any postal service location.

Once we receive the item at our warehouse, we'll issue the refund directly to your original payment method. Also, I see you're one of our VIP customers, and we sincerely apologize for the trouble with the blisters. As a courtesy, I've added a 20% discount voucher to your account for your next purchase with us.
Great. Maybe I can buy some bandages with it. Thanks, I guess.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
